To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have purified a peptide that stimulates primary urine production of the Malpignian tubules of single isolated ants.

a diuretic peptide from F. polyctenas was purified, sequenced and identified as an ionophore that increases the calcium concentration in the cells of the Malpghian tubules and thereby stimulates fluid secretion.
a novel peptide has been identified that stimulates primary urine production in isolated Malpighial tubules of Formica polyctana.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the purification and identification of a diuretic peptide from the ant, F. polyctenta.
the identification of a peptide which stimulates the fluid secretion of Malpighian tubes of Formica polyctenain vitro.

the purification of a peptide that is capable of stimulating primary urine production in isolated Malpighians of the ant Formica polyctenaa and with the identification of its cellular transduction mechanism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

FopDP is a peptide that stimulates primary urine production in single isolated Malpignian tubules of F. polyctaena and that this effect is mediated by an increase in intracellular calcium concentration.
FopDP is a peptide that stimulates primary urine production of isolated Malpighia tubules of the ant, Formica Polyctena, and that it uses an intracellular Ca++ signal transduction mechanism.
FopDP is a novel peptide that stimulates the fluid secretion of Malpighian tubes of the ant, Formica Polyctena, and that this peptide is a member of the family of calcium ionophores.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FopDP stimulates the fluid secretion of the Malpignian tubule of Formica polyctene by increasing the intracellular calcium concentration.
we have purified and partially identified an insect diuretic peptide that uses an increase of the cytosolic calcium concentration as cellular transduction pathway.
the diuretic peptide of the ant, Formica Polyctena (FopDP), has a molecular mass of about 7514 dalton, is a novel peptide with a unique structure and is a calcium ionophor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we were able to purify and characterise the first insect diuretic peptide of a social insect.
the FopDP sequence is different from all other insect diuretic peptide sequences.
the peptide is a new diuretic hormone in the insect kingdom.
